spec.studio_prompt: A large elongated bell-shaped pendant shade measuring 75 cm in height and 55 cm in diameter, masterfully woven from natural rattan fiber. The silhouette tapers from a narrow top aperture into a tall, swelling dome with an open circular base. Its exterior features intricate horizontal bands of semi-open diagonal and chevron lattice weaves, displaying organic fibers in warm tan #886c4b, light straw beige #a49075, bleached natural cane #bfbab1, and deep toasted brown #573f29. The fibrous texture forms an airy, semi-translucent shell supported by subtle internal framing.
